USER: Hi, I'd like to apply for a home mortgage loan.
ASSISTANT: Good morning! I'm Robert from Wells Fargo Home Lending. I'll help you with your mortgage application today. Let's start with some basic information. What's your full legal name?
USER: David Alexander Thompson.
ASSISTANT: Thank you, Mr. Thompson. And your date of birth?
USER: July 22nd, 1982.
ASSISTANT: What's your Social Security number?
USER: 652-41-8897.
ASSISTANT: And your current address?
USER: 2156 Riverside Drive, Apartment 14C, Chicago, Illinois 60601.
ASSISTANT: How long have you lived at this address?
USER: About three years and four months.
ASSISTANT: Are you currently renting or do you own?
USER: I'm renting. The monthly rent is $2,450.
ASSISTANT: Who's your landlord or management company?
USER: Citywide Property Management LLC.
ASSISTANT: Thank you. Now, let's discuss your employment. Current employer?
USER: I work for McKenzie Financial Advisors.
ASSISTANT: Your position there?
USER: Senior Financial Analyst.
ASSISTANT: How long have you been with McKenzie Financial?
USER: Six years and two months.
ASSISTANT: And your annual salary?
USER: My base salary is $145,000 per year.
ASSISTANT: Do you receive any bonuses or additional compensation?
USER: Yes, I typically get an annual bonus. Last year it was $28,500.
ASSISTANT: Any other sources of income?
USER: I do some freelance consulting, averaging about $1,800 per month.
ASSISTANT: How long have you been doing the consulting work?
USER: For about two years now.
ASSISTANT: Do you have a business name or is it under your personal name?
USER: It's under Thompson Consulting LLC.
ASSISTANT: Great. Now let's talk about your assets. What's your total in checking accounts?
USER: I have about $18,500 in my Chase checking account.
ASSISTANT: Savings accounts?
USER: I have $67,000 in my Wells Fargo savings and another $45,000 in a Marcus by Goldman Sachs high-yield savings.
ASSISTANT: Any investment accounts?
USER: Yes, I have a Vanguard brokerage account with about $125,000 and a TD Ameritrade account with $38,000.
ASSISTANT: What about retirement accounts?
USER: My 401k with my employer has around $285,000, and I have a Roth IRA at Fidelity with $78,000.
ASSISTANT: Excellent. Now, any liabilities? Credit card debt?
USER: I have three credit cards. The Visa has a $2,300 balance, MasterCard is paid off, and my Amex has about $1,100.
ASSISTANT: What are the credit limits on those cards?
USER: The Visa is $15,000 limit, MasterCard is $12,000, and Amex is $25,000.
ASSISTANT: Any auto loans?
USER: Yes, I have a car loan with BMW Financial. The balance is $31,500.
ASSISTANT: Monthly payment?
USER: $685 per month.
ASSISTANT: Interest rate on that loan?
USER: It's 3.9%.
ASSISTANT: Any student loans?
USER: No, I paid those off two years ago.
ASSISTANT: Other debts or monthly obligations?
USER: No, that's everything.
ASSISTANT: Now, about the property you're looking to purchase. What's the address?
USER: It's 789 Oak Park Avenue, Evanston, Illinois 60201.
ASSISTANT: Purchase price?
USER: $625,000.
ASSISTANT: How much are you planning to put down?
USER: I'm planning to put down 20%, so $125,000.
ASSISTANT: So you're looking to borrow $500,000?
USER: Exactly.
ASSISTANT: Have you already made an offer?
USER: Yes, it was accepted. We're in attorney review until December 5th.
ASSISTANT: When's the planned closing date?
USER: January 15th, 2025.
ASSISTANT: Is this going to be your primary residence?
USER: Yes, absolutely.
ASSISTANT: Are you purchasing alone or with someone else?
USER: Just me, I'm buying it alone.
ASSISTANT: Are you a first-time homebuyer?
USER: No, I owned a condo about eight years ago but sold it when I relocated for work.
ASSISTANT: What did you sell that property for?
USER: I sold it for $285,000 back in 2016.
ASSISTANT: Did you have any gain or loss on that sale?
USER: I made about a $45,000 profit after all expenses.
ASSISTANT: Good. Now, do you have a preference for loan type? 30-year fixed, 15-year fixed, or adjustable rate?
USER: I'm interested in a 30-year fixed rate.
ASSISTANT: Based on your credit score range, which we'll verify, current rates are around 6.875% for a 30-year fixed with 20% down.
USER: Speaking of credit score, what do you need?
ASSISTANT: We'll pull your credit report. Do you know your approximate score?
USER: Last I checked it was 782.
ASSISTANT: Excellent score. That should qualify you for our best rates. Have you had any late payments in the last two years?
USER: No, no late payments at all.
ASSISTANT: Any bankruptcies or foreclosures?
USER: No, never.
ASSISTANT: Have you co-signed any loans for anyone?
USER: Actually yes, I co-signed my sister's student loan about five years ago.
ASSISTANT: What's the balance on that loan?
USER: It's down to about $18,000 now.
ASSISTANT: Is she current on payments?
USER: Yes, she's never missed a payment.
ASSISTANT: Good. Now, for the down payment, where will those funds come from?
USER: From my savings accounts - the Wells Fargo and Marcus accounts I mentioned.
ASSISTANT: Will any of the down payment be a gift from family?
USER: No, it's all my own savings.
ASSISTANT: Have you made any large deposits to your accounts in the last 60 days?
USER: Just my regular salary and the consulting income. Oh, and I got my annual bonus of $28,500 deposited about three weeks ago.
ASSISTANT: That's fine, we'll just need documentation for that. Now, regarding the property, what type of home is it?
USER: It's a single-family home, built in 1998.
ASSISTANT: How many bedrooms and bathrooms?
USER: Four bedrooms, three and a half bathrooms.
ASSISTANT: Square footage?
USER: About 3,200 square feet.
ASSISTANT: Is there a homeowners association?
USER: Yes, the HOA fee is $185 per month.
ASSISTANT: What does that cover?
USER: Landscaping of common areas, snow removal, and maintenance of the community park and pool.
ASSISTANT: Annual property taxes?
USER: They're about $14,800 per year.
ASSISTANT: Has a home inspection been done yet?
USER: Scheduled for next Tuesday, November 26th.
ASSISTANT: Good. Now, let me calculate your debt-to-income ratio. Your monthly gross income including the consulting would be about $14,267, correct?
USER: That sounds right.
ASSISTANT: With the mortgage payment, taxes, insurance, HOA, and your car payment, your total monthly housing and debt payments would be approximately $4,285. That gives you a debt-to-income ratio of about 30%, which is excellent.
USER: That's good to hear.
ASSISTANT: For the loan application, I'll need several documents. Do you have your last two years of tax returns?
USER: Yes, I have 2022 and 2023 returns ready.
ASSISTANT: Last two months of pay stubs?
USER: I can download those from our HR portal.
ASSISTANT: Last two months of bank statements for all accounts?
USER: I'll need to gather those.
ASSISTANT: And we'll need the purchase agreement and your employer's contact information for verification.
USER: The purchase agreement is with my attorney. My HR department number is 312-555-8900.
ASSISTANT: Perfect. Once we receive all documents, the underwriting process typically takes 3-4 weeks.
USER: That should work with our January 15th closing.
ASSISTANT: Yes, we'll have plenty of time. I'll email you the full application and document checklist. What's your email address?
USER: It's dthompson82@email.com
ASSISTANT: Great. I'll send that within the hour. Any questions about the mortgage process?
USER: What about mortgage insurance?
ASSISTANT: With 20% down, you won't need PMI - private mortgage insurance.
USER: Perfect. And when do I lock in the interest rate?
ASSISTANT: You can lock anytime between now and closing. We offer 30, 45, or 60-day locks. Given your January 15th closing, I'd recommend a 60-day lock for safety.
USER: What if rates drop after I lock?
ASSISTANT: We have a one-time float-down option if rates drop by at least 0.25% from your locked rate.
USER: That's good to know. I think I'll wait a week or two before locking.
ASSISTANT: That's fine. Just keep in mind rates can change daily. I'll monitor them and keep you informed.
USER: Please do. I think that covers everything I needed to know today.
ASSISTANT: Excellent. I'll process your application and send you the document list. My direct line is 312-555-7600 if you have any questions.
USER: Thank you, Robert. I'll gather those documents and send them over soon.
ASSISTANT: Perfect. Congratulations on your home purchase, Mr. Thompson. We'll make sure everything goes smoothly for your closing.
